item.title: How do you create error bars using data from a column in Excel?
item.description:
I'm currently trying to make graphical visuals for my PhD research and I'm having some difficulty.
I'm trying to make a bar graph with two variables. I've been able to make and tweak the graph to how I want it (so far), but I need to add error bars to each graph.
The thing is I have the values for the error bars in a column in my Excel dataset. I just have no idea how to transfer a column of data into error bars. I've looked everywhere online and I've only found ways to compute it in R (i.e., "geom\_errorbar(aes(ymin = xxx-sd, ymax = xxx+sd))") which is what I do not want to do (because it'll give me a different value--plus I'm not using standard deviation or standard error, I'm using uncertainty). Is this possible to do within ggplot or another package? I'm starting to feel like I'm going to have to painfully make this in Excel.
Thanks!
